item.title: Help to appoint significances
item.description:
Hello! I have a question. I have a dataset drup\_XR. I want to appoint significances between the means (the mean of the 3 repititions) of Dmax of the groups under the 'adj' header (act, das, squ, tren, wat). Below is my code and I get this result: act: ab, das: a, squ: b, tren: a, wat: ab. But seeing that the mean of the squ group is highest, I want to appoint the letter a to it (instead of b). Is it possible to just manually reverse it like this: act: ab, das: b, squ: a, tren: b, wat: ab, or is this statistically incorrect? Anyway, I would like to know how to code this in r with it still being statistically correct. I have to do this 100 more times, so an elegant solution would be helpful. Help :'(.
https://preview.redd.it/utnudgd7m00f1.png?width=326&format=png&auto=webp&s=ba52e434911bb30957be1ff07b7aa5ac00d10d58
"shapiro.test(drup\_XR$Dmax)
leveneTest(drup\_XR$Dmax,drup\_XR$adj)
kruskal.test(Dmax \~ adj, data = drup\_XR)
dunn\_result <- dunn.test(drup\_XR$Dmax, drup\_XR$adj, method = "bonferroni")
dunn\_result\_df <- as.data.frame(dunn\_result)
cld\_list\_sizea <- cldList(P.adjusted \~ comparisons, data = dunn\_result\_df)
print(cld\_list\_sizea)"
